newsitem.title: USA: PSE reverses decision on Good Ideas delist.
newsitem.headline: PSE reverses decision on Good Ideas delist.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Thursday it would not delist shares of Good Ideas Enterprises Inc.

The exchange had said Wednesday it suspended trading in Good Ideas with the intention of delisting it because of the company's failure to comply with its listing maintenance requirements for share bid price and market value.
The decision was reversed "on the basis of new information provided to the exchange by the company," the PSE said in a statement. No further details were available.
Good Ideas stock was off 2/16 3/16 Thursday.
